objective: Measure representation transfer before attempting risk-model transfer; no target-specific repair in this run.
freeze: Hash analyzer, protocol, sources and dependencies before fresh extraction. Identical APIs and summaries for development and target. No manual target slot, SQL sink or guard mapping.
evaluation_unit: Module for representation coverage. Static PreparedStatement declarations, setter sites and timestamp roots are denominators, not executions or independent samples.
measurements: attributed statement declarations with finite SQL text
setter sites with understood value terms
existing inspect_binding API coverage over distinct owner/slot pairs
existing timestamp-root sink recovery and unknown reasons
risk_evaluation: Not yet available: no shared candidate-pair representation, target variants or target behavioral labels. Do not convert raw extraction coverage into risk accuracy or give the unmodified module a zero-risk score.
unknown_policy: Retain unknown terms and failed/unsupported analyses; never fill absent effects with zero. A partial graph is not a complete capability DAG.
target_exposure: Delivery is held out from the current NewOrder/Payment feature-design experiment, not an unseen project. Project source and application executions exist in prior work. This is not an independent blind generalization test.

next_evaluation_contract.split: Keep original/candidate variants, fixes and scenarios of a target module together. Do not randomly split requests from one module across train/test.
next_evaluation_contract.prediction_freeze: Freeze representation, fitted source-only weights and target predictions before executing target candidate oracles. Target labels cannot determine feature selection, normalization, thresholds or stopping.
next_evaluation_contract.oracle: Same ordered inputs, complete response, per-request observation and full nine-table state. Preserve all business data and retain failures and unexecuted suffixes.
metrics: Brier and log loss versus source-only prior on the same scored cohort
incorrect candidates below the frozen risk threshold
next_evaluation_contract.success_scope: Cross-module evidence within one project only; cross-project generalization requires a separate project-held-out test. No declaration of calibrated deletion probability.
next_evaluation_contract.failure_stop: Report an unsupported representation or negative transfer without patching the held-out target and rerunning it as if still unseen. Any later adaptation is a development phase with a new reserved evaluation target.

stop: One static extraction per development/target module and one unchanged graph recovery. No parser extension, fitting, business executions, performance work or automatic deletion.
